title: 5 Mi to Honky Tonk Hwy! Charming Escape w/ Porch
description:
Music-Themed Decor | Washer & Dryer | 4 Mi to Nissan Stadium | 8 Mi to Grand Ole Opry

Game day starts easily from this North Nashville vacation rental, a short drive from stadium events and the energy of downtown. Sip coffee from the porch before heading out, then let the day unfold, whether that means cheering on the Titans, wandering Broadway's honky-tonks, or catching the skyline from Wasioto Park. Book this charming home today and see where Music City takes you!

The space
OUTDOOR LIVING
- Yard (unfenced) 
- Furnished porch

INDOOR LIVING
- Central air conditioning & heating
- Smart TV
- Washer & dryer
- Portable crib

KITCHEN 
- Keurig coffee maker (starter coffee provided)
- Refrigerator, stove/oven, dining table
- Microwave, toaster
- Cooking basics, dishware & flatware

ACCESSIBILITY
- Single-story home, stairs required

PARKING
- Driveway (2 vehicles, shared w/ neighboring home)

Guest access
Guests will have access to the entire property via keyless entry

Other things to note
- No smoking
- Pet friendly w/ $100 fee (+ taxes & fees)
- No events, parties, or large gatherings
- Additional fees and taxes may apply
- Photo ID may be required upon check-in
